list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES WITH KEY = "role" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES WITH KEY = "role" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/

panels.title: Fetch rate
panels.description: Bytes per second the FUSE clients fetch from data nodes (cache hits excluded), summed over the selection. Should follow the number of active streams.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "tier", "src_dc" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Cache misses
panels.description: Chunk reads over the selected range that no client cache served and had to go to a data node. A high count with slow reads means readahead is not keeping up.

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "total" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_misses" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY "node") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: FUSE op errors
panels.description: Failed FUSE operations over the selected range. Anything above 0 means a player may have seen an I/O error; see the errno panel. ENOENT and EEXIST are left out: a lookup of a missing name or a create of an existing one is a normal answer, not a failure (the errno panels show them).

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "total" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_fuse_op_errors" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "errno" !~ /^(ENOENT|EEXIST)$/ GROUP BY "node", "op", "errno") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Get failures
panels.description: Failed chunk fetches from data nodes over the selected range. Each one costs a failover to another replica; 0 is normal.

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "total" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_failures" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY "node", "tier", "src_dc") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Read failovers
panels.description: Reads that had to switch replica (integrity, timeout or error) over the selected range. 0 is normal; any value costs the stream latency.

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "total" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_fuse_read_failovers" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY "node", "reason") WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: FUSE read p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of FUSE read calls, maximum across the selected nodes. Sustained values above a few seconds starve a Plex stream.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_fuse_op_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "op" =~ /^read$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: FUSE read p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile of FUSE read calls per client node. Spikes line up with stalls the player sees.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_fuse_op_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "op" =~ /^read$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: FUSE metadata op p99 by op
panels.description: 99th percentile of lookup, getattr, open and readdir calls. Slow metadata delays playback start and library scans; normally well under a second.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_fuse_op_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "op" =~ /^(lookup|getattr|open|readdir|readdirplus)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "op" fill(null)

panels.title: FUSE op errors by op and errno
panels.description: Failed FUSE operations per second by op and errno (EIO is what the player sees; other lists unlisted errnos). Normally empty.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_op_errors" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "op", "errno" fill(null)

panels.title: Metadata cache share (hit / miss)
panels.description: Share of metadata lookups served from the client metadata cache versus the manager, for the selected nodes. Mostly hits is normal.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_meta_cache_hits" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_meta_cache_misses" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Chunk cache share (readahead hit / disk hit / miss)
panels.description: Where reads were served: readahead memory, disk cache or a data node (miss), for the selected nodes. A growing miss share means more network reads.

targets.query: SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_hits" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "layer" =~ /^readahead$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "layer" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_hits" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "layer" =~ /^disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "layer" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT sum("r") AS "rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "r" FROM "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_misses" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Chunk cache hit bytes by layer
panels.description: Bytes per second served from the readahead and disk cache layers per node.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_chunk_cache_hit_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "layer" fill(null)

panels.title: Single-flight merges
panels.description: Reads merged onto a fetch already in flight (kind), and merged fetches whose owner failed. Merges are good; owner failed means a shared fetch error.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_singleflight_merges" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "kind" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_singleflight_owner_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead issued and failed
panels.description: Readahead fetches started and failed per second. Failed should stay near 0.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_issued" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead fetched vs wasted bytes
panels.description: Bytes prefetched per second against bytes discarded unread (budget: cache was full, drop: file closed or seeked). Wasted close to fetched means readahead burns bandwidth for nothing.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_evicted_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reason" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead GET p99 latency
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of background readahead GetChunk calls. Must stay well below the time a stream needs to consume a chunk.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_get_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead cache vs budget
panels.description: Bytes held in the readahead cache against its budget. Sitting at the budget means readahead is throttled by memory.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_cache_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_budget_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead pending and window
panels.description: Readahead fetches in flight and the prefetch window in chunks of the active mode. Pending stuck at the cap means slow data nodes.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_pending" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_window_chunks" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Readahead mode
panels.description: Readahead mode each selected client runs with (file-sequential, folder-sequential, file-only or disabled). Set at mount time.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_fuse_readahead_mode" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "mode" fill(null)

panels.title: Replica chosen by tier and DC
panels.description: Which replica the client picked per read, by tier and source DC. Reads from a remote DC mean no cache copy was close; expect the reader's own DC to dominate.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_read_replica_chosen" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "tier", "src_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: GetChunk p99 latency by tier and DC
panels.description: 99th percentile GetChunk latency per source tier and DC. A slow source here explains slow reads; compare local with remote DCs.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "tier", "src_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: GetChunk bytes by tier and DC
panels.description: Bytes per second fetched per source tier and DC. Shows how much of the stream load crosses the slow WAN links.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "tier", "src_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: GetChunk failures by tier and DC
panels.description: Failed chunk fetches per second by source tier and DC. A source that fails repeatedly is down or unreachable.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_failures" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "tier", "src_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: Read failovers and verify failures
panels.description: Replica switches by reason (integrity, timeout, error) and client-side BLAKE3 mismatches per second. Verify failures mean corrupt data was received and rejected.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_read_failovers" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reason" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_read_verify_failures" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Fill on read issued and failed
panels.description: Cache fills the client started after a read and those that failed. Failed fills are retried on a later read and cost only bandwidth.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_cache_fill_issued" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_fuse_cache_fill_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Fill on read bytes registered
panels.description: Bytes of cache fills registered by the managers per second, by reader DC. A manager metric: select the manager role and nodes to see it.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_cache_fill_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "reader_dc" fill(null)

panels.title: Data node get stages (p99)
panels.description: 99th percentile per get stage (disk read, network send, hash verify, total), maximum across the selected nodes and disks. The stage close to total is the bottleneck.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_read_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_send_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_verify_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Data node get p99 by disk
panels.description: 99th percentile of whole GetChunk calls per node, disk and tier. A single slow disk or HDD tier shows up as its own line.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Data node gets in flight
panels.description: GetChunk calls being served right now per node. A pile-up means the node cannot keep up.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "v" FROM "dtfs_data_get_inflight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Data node gets by disk
panels.description: GetChunk calls served per second per node, disk and tier.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_data_gets_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Data node get throughput by disk
panels.description: Bytes per second served per node, disk and tier.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_data_get_bytes_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Data node get not found and data loss
panels.description: Gets for unknown chunks and reads that failed verification, per second. Both should be 0; data loss means a corrupt replica on that disk.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_data_get_not_found_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rate" FROM "dtfs_data_get_data_loss_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "role" =~ /^$role$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)
